Summaries.eng: Ash Ketchum, Brock (Pokémon) and List of characters in the Pokémon anime series#Dawn are at a Pokémon Center watching a Pokémon Baccer match on TV. Ash and co. are intrigued by the match and decide to head to Crown City to watch the Pokémon Baccer World Cup.
